notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Burning Cars
notes.notes:
Burning Cars is Now Available on Steam!

He got close a few times, but never won it: the Trashpit Championship. As skilled behind the wheel as your father was, there was something missing. Maybe it was instinct, maybe ferocity, or the hummingbird beat reactions that success on the track demands. Regardless, his racing days are over; that’s why he gave you the keys to his old truck, and a little money to get started. His racing days are over, but yours have just begun…


Stunning effects, amazing fire, hard racing with bullets - is that what you waiting for so long. Old school gamer's can hear 'rock'n'roll' in noise of madly spinning tire on the start. Just get in car and try to survive on a track. Be quick, be smart, be fearless and Trashpit Cup waiting you. And don't forget take good minigun and couple of mines, this is necessary for living on track.
